gen-press-start-2p-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Retro pixel fun from Press Start 2P, then Mochiy Pop P One draws a sans with a single flat line weight. Slight modulation up top meets wide, loose spacing below, so everything stays playful.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam holds its curve endings well apart and stands its c, s and z tall and full. Press Start 2P adds the retro bite; the sans keeps the lines quiet.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-bassa-va: Noto Sans Bassa Vah has a dominant midsection that swallows the line's height and a c with an open jaw. Press Start 2P pins cut-out letters far apart, making the pair unmistakably retro.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Retro Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart, with only moderate contrast. Noto Sans Buginese then settles in with open letter mouths and short ascenders, a sans-serif that stays low in contrast.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid follows Press Start 2P, whose fun, retro letters are pinned far apart. Noto Sans Buhid leaves generous room between curve ends and stems, and its high x-height keeps paragraphs legible.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-cuneifor: Pixel-bright and playful, Press Start 2P keeps modulation light and lowercase bowls big. Noto Sans Cuneiform handles the reading, with an open e and a lowercase swollen like glass beads.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart. Noto Sans Ogham backs the pixel heading with wide gaps in the e and tall bodies that look bold.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Fun and stencil-cut, Press Start 2P varies its bar widths only mildly. Noto Sans Ol Chiki is the plain sans counterpart, holding its curve tails well back so words form solid blocks.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-ital: Cut-out letters pinned far apart give Press Start 2P its retro, fun look, with only light modulation. Noto Sans Old Italic steadies the page, its x-height nearly meeting cap height.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-nort: Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs a dense, tall lowercase band, its terminals flaring outward like tongs, under Press Start 2P. Paragraphs in this sans come out dense, firm and approachable.
